lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.criterion: State completeness — a Proposal whose base revision is stale remains presented as waiting for review in the reconciled action sheet
findings.observation: On iPhone 17 Pro after an owned-action response is lost and then reconciled, evidence/screenshots/action-response-loss-reconciled.png directly shows ACTIVE · REVISION 2 and, in the same Pursuit sheet, WAITING FOR REVIEW with a Proposal at base revision 1. The frozen source at apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveView.swift:2120 filters pendingProposals by Pursuit ID but not by baseRevision, while the Proposal review path is revision checked. This is direct evidence of a stale review affordance, not evidence of an unsafe write.
findings.evidence: [direct] evidence/screenshots/action-response-loss-reconciled.png; apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveView.swift:1914-1935 and 2120-2122; apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:794-905. [supported inference] The backend revision gate should reject the stale review, so the likely result is a recoverable conflict rather than duplicate mutation.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter who has just recovered an uncertain action outcome can be sent into a review that can no longer apply, adding a confusing 409-style dead end at the exact moment the interface otherwise restores trust.
findings.recommendation: Compare every open Proposal baseRevision with the currently displayed Pursuit revision. Replace the review affordance with a calm 'Proposal is out of date' state and a refresh or restage route, or supersede the Proposal canonically when another operation advances its Pursuit revision.
findings.verification: Seed one needs_review Proposal at revision 1, complete an owned action so the Pursuit becomes revision 2, reconcile after response loss, and assert that no actionable 'Waiting for review' row exists for the revision-1 Proposal; assert an explicit stale-state explanation and that no review POST is made from that row. Repeat after sheet dismissal and relaunch.

findings.criterion: Feedback and recovery — evidence-review response loss and terminal-persistence failure are proven by components rather than one frozen end-to-end mobile journey
findings.observation: The frozen implementation directly persists an evidence-review operation before sending, binds it to the exact predecessor review ID, uses a Session-owned in-flight claim, persists superseded when possible, blocks retry with an in-memory superseded sentinel when that terminal save fails, and preserves a nonempty Ask draft. Unit tests separately prove persisted unknown-state recovery, persisted superseded relaunch, Session-only transient failure blocking, and draft preservation; backend runtime proves same-cycle replay and stale replay rejection. The frozen iOS runtime summary does not name a UI journey that drops an evidence-review response, dismisses/reopens or relaunches, and observes the terminal card without a second canonical review.
findings.evidence: [direct] apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveModels.swift:528-732 and 940-965; apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:696-835 and 1188-1359; apps/ios/Tests/RelationshipArchiveTests.swift:132-459; evidence/backend-check/evidence-review-authority-runtime.json; evidence/ios-full-suite-runtime.json. [supported inference] Exact backend authority and idempotency make duplicate review unlikely, but the complete presentation-to-process-death recovery experience was not directly frozen.
findings.user_impact: The safety boundary is strong, yet the most interruption-prone evidence correction flow still lacks direct proof that a recruiter sees the right terminal explanation and never sees obsolete retry authority across the full combined failure sequence.
findings.recommendation: Add a response-loss proxy journey for evidence review: persist the operation, drop the first successful response, dismiss and reopen, reconcile with the same key, then advance the source with a newer review and force terminal local-save failure. Verify same-session blocking, process relaunch behavior, current-evidence CTA, preserved draft, and exact review-count readback.
findings.verification: Freeze the locked, superseded/current-evidence, and reconciled UI states plus proxy counters. Require exactly one review for the original authority cycle, a 409 stale rejection after a newer cycle, no old Retry control once superseded is known, and unchanged nonempty Ask draft text.

findings.criterion: Accessibility — automated AX5 and audit coverage does not establish manual VoiceOver completion
findings.observation: Direct Simulator evidence covers iPhone SE 375×667 in dark mode at AX5, reachable Capture, audio consent/stop, Proposal review, action outcome, hit regions, descriptions, contrast checks, reduced motion, and evidence-before-decision accessibility order. The artifact explicitly records V1-TST-004 as partial because no human completed the full critical journey with VoiceOver. Under the mobile rubric, static screenshots and XCTest hierarchy cannot prove spoken order, duplicate speech, focus restoration, rotor behavior, or real assistive-technology task completion.
findings.evidence: [direct] evidence/ios-375x667-runtime.json; evidence/ios-full-suite-runtime.json; evidence/screenshots/se-375x667-ax5-today.png; evidence/screenshots/se-375x667-capture-chooser.png; evidence/screenshots/se-375x667-proposal-receipt.png; apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:454-615 and 1585-1705; evidence/requirement-trace.json. [supported inference] The semantic labels, containment, 44-point controls, and observed AX5 layouts make the path likely usable, but they do not replace a VoiceOver user journey.
findings.user_impact: A VoiceOver user could still encounter a focus jump, overly combined evidence, duplicated status speech, or an action announced before its evidence even though the visual and automated hierarchy passes.
findings.recommendation: Run a human VoiceOver audit on a small and large physical iPhone through choose capture, inspect source, same-name scope selection, fact review, Proposal apply, response-loss recovery, exact Ask citation/action, and deletion. Record focus order, labels, hints, errors, back navigation, and completion time.
findings.verification: Retain a narrated screen recording and an issue log showing the complete critical journey succeeds without sight, essential evidence precedes each decision, every result and unknown state is announced once, focus returns to the triggering control or next safe action, and no clipped text is the only accessible form of identity, deadline, or effect.

strengths: [direct] Frozen-package integrity is sound: all 195 declared source files, the aggregate source digest, 14 runtime artifacts, and 21 screenshots match artifact.json; the declared commit matches the reviewed HEAD.

[direct] The visual system is calm and content-led across light and dark evidence: Today gives one dominant work decision, Proposal review puts before/proposed/reason/effect and evidence count together, receipts disclose revision and actor, and vermilion is used for attention or changed authority rather than candidate worth.

[direct] Same-name binding does not rely on the display name: the picker and accessibility label include relationship context plus a stable Person-record prefix, nothing is preselected, the UI test explicitly selects search B, relaunches, syncs, and reads back the exact Person/role/context IDs.

[direct] Proposal and owned-action response-loss states avoid false success. Frozen locked screens say outcome unknown, successful readback is absent until reconciliation, relaunch restores the same operation, proxy counters increase by exactly one POST, and reconciled receipts disclose canonical revision and empty external effects.

[direct] Evidence-review authority is exact rather than status-only: iOS sends expected_last_review_id and validates prior_review_id; the backend locks fragment/resource/capture/authorization rows, persists revisioned predecessor links, permits same-cycle idempotent replay only while that review remains current, and rejects an old replay after a newer review.

[direct] Superseded evidence-review UX removes obsolete retry in the known Session: persisted superseded survives relaunch, transient terminal-save failure blocks claim and pending mutation for the active Session, the UI offers only 'Ask with current evidence', and the draft policy does not overwrite existing recruiter text.

[direct] Deletion feedback is ordered truthfully: the Text Signal store requires a canonical deleted readback before removing protected local content, the receipt states server confirmation followed by local removal, and backend evidence shows source-derived Proposal summary/reason/effect/decided value redacted with the deletion canary absent from API and operational stores.

[direct] Temporal authority and exact navigation are visible: unavailable gap evidence is labeled 'Originally evidence-supported · Evidence unavailable', the exact Ask target carries a typed pursuit/action reference, and opening it highlights 'Referenced in Ask' on the matching owned action without recording a change.

[direct] The 375×667 AX5 dark evidence remains readable and scroll-reachable: Capture choices, audio authorization and stop, Proposal receipt, action outcome, persistent navigation, and the bottom Ask rail survive the constrained viewport; the rail is a safe-area inset rather than an unaccounted overlay.
missing_evidence: Complete manual VoiceOver traversal by a human, including focus restoration and spoken recovery states, is missing on both small and large physical iPhones.
Physical-device Action Button/App Shortcut feedback, microphone permission and recording lifecycle, file protection while locked, and system-capture privacy behavior are not proven.

A single end-to-end UI/proxy run combining evidence-review response loss, sheet dismissal/reopen, newer authority, terminal local-save failure, process termination, and relaunch is not frozen; current proof covers these guards separately.
Five credentialed, pinned-model live Claude Agent SDK trials are absent; the live artifact correctly reports not_run_missing_credentials and missing_proof.
Production authentication, regional retention/deletion operations, provider reconciliation, cross-tenant adversarial tests, and real candidate-data handling are intentionally unproven.
Recruiter and authorized candidate field outcomes, first-use comprehension, seeded-error correction rates, and sustained workflow value are absent.

The frozen mobile matrix does not directly cover landscape, oldest deployment target, increased contrast, reduce transparency, 200% localization expansion, RTL, full Chinese critical-path completion, Full Keyboard Access, or Switch Control.
No physical-device critical-path latency, energy, launch, scroll-jank, or degraded-network performance budget is included.
open_questions: Should a needs_review Proposal whose base revision no longer equals the current Pursuit revision remain visible as non-actionable audit history, or should the backend supersede it immediately when another governed operation advances the Pursuit?

Can the combined terminal-save-failure plus process-death scenario persist a minimal superseded tombstone independently, or is revalidation on relaunch the intended product contract before any retry affordance is rendered?
What manual VoiceOver and physical-device evidence is required as the explicit production release gate rather than as a post-merge follow-up?
Which minimum locale, older-iOS, contrast, reduced-transparency, and assistive-input matrix will define V1 production support?
